doesNotKnow: Compute selected and unselected states per tree vertex to optimize a weighted independent set.

misconception: Choosing the heaviest remaining vertex greedily maximizes a tree's independent-set weight.
objective: Compute selected and unselected states per tree vertex to optimize a weighted independent set.

claims.text: Selecting a vertex requires skipping each child. Skipping it leaves each child free to choose its better state, allowing a collection of smaller compatible weights to beat one large weight.
